answer_1.quote: We benchmark trlX on two popular RLHF tasks: OpenAI's learning to summarize TL;DR dataset and Anthropic's Helpful QA dataset.

answer_2.quote: We attach a table in the appendix showing the result of the ROUGE scores in the test set of the TL;DR dataset... We then evaluate vanilla models, SFT models, PPO models, Vanilla-PPO models, and ILQL models on a set of common academic benchmarks including LAMBADA, ARC, Open-BookQA, TriviaQA, and HellaSwag.

answer_4.quote: we conduct a human evaluation... we ask annotators to choose between two candidate summaries... we ask users to score the coverage, clarity, and inconsistency on a 1-7 Likert scale... we also collect Likert scores on a scale of 1-7 for response Helpfulness, Harmfulness, and Honesty.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to choose between two candidate outputs and to rate them on a 1-7 Likert scale for specific criteria.
